scenario.note: Mostly calm graph: omeprazole-citalopram (CYP2C19) and bleeding/brain-fog meters already elevated.
Paxlovid: CYP3A4 lights up; simvastatin contraindicated.
Antibiotic: more CYP3A4 load plus QT stacking with citalopram.
Fix this regimen: statin, SSRI, bladder drug, PPI and antibiotic swaps; apixaban and amlodipine flagged for clinician.
